name: Facet
text: Choose dark mode by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low light and keeps the interface sleek, matching Manus’ competitive analysis. The trade-off is that some users prefer light mode for readability in bright environments, but the toggle covers that need without cluttering the design.

name: Pane
text: Dark mode hides errors when contrast drops—Manus’s analysis warns this. A one-click toggle doesn’t solve the problem; it just moves it. Better alternative: start with high-contrast light mode, then offer a dark mode toggle for users who prefer it. Settle it with A/B testing: measure error rates and readability in both modes under real-world lighting conditions.
